faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about getting started on Sprace.
faq.a1: Sprace is a marketplace that connects businesses with influencers and UGC creators in the Nordics. You can discover creators, send briefs, manage collaborations, and handle payments — all in one place.
faq.q2: How much does it cost to use Sprace?
faq.a2: Signing up is completely free for both creators and businesses. Sprace charges a transparent 15 % platform fee on each completed booking, deducted automatically when funds are released to the creator.
faq.a3: When a creator accepts a brief, the business pays upfront. The money is held in escrow by Stripe until the deliverables are approved, at which point the creator receives the payout minus the platform fee. If a booking is cancelled before delivery, the business gets a full refund.
faq.a4: Every creator goes through a review process before their profile goes live. We check portfolio quality, social media presence, and profile completeness to ensure businesses find professional, reliable partners.
faq.q5: Can I request revisions on delivered content?
faq.a5: Yes. Each booking includes a set number of revision rounds (typically 3). If the delivered content doesn't match the brief, you can request changes with specific feedback before approving the final version.
faq.q6: What happens if there's a dispute?
faq.a6: Either party can open a dispute from the booking page. Our team reviews the case and can issue a full refund, partial refund, or release the payment to the creator — depending on the circumstances.
faq.q7: What types of content can I book?
faq.a7: Creators on Sprace offer a wide range of services — from Instagram reels and TikTok videos to product photography, blog posts, and UGC ad creatives. You can filter by specialty to find the right match.

forCreators.heroSubtitle: Join the Nordics' leading marketplace for influencers and UGC creators. Set your own rates, work with the brands you love, and get paid reliably — we handle the admin.
forCreators.benefitsSubtitle: Everything you need to run your creator business — in one place.
forCreators.benefit1Body: You decide what your work is worth. List services with clear pricing and keep 85 % of every booking.
forCreators.benefit2Body: Businesses pay upfront into escrow. When you deliver and the brief is approved, funds land in your account automatically.
forCreators.benefit3Body: Every business is verified. No more ghost DMs, no more chasing invoices — just real projects with real budgets.
forCreators.benefit4Body: Accept or decline every booking. Choose which brands you work with and at what pace — Sprace fits around your life.
forCreators.benefit5Body: Chat with the brand, upload final files, request revisions — all in one thread tied to the booking.
forCreators.benefit6Body: Collect verified reviews from brands you've worked with. Your profile becomes your portfolio — and your proof.
forCreators.flowSubtitle: From signup to first payout in days, not months.
forCreators.flow1Body: Add your bio, specialties, social links, and a few portfolio pieces. Our team reviews new profiles within 48 hours.
forCreators.flow2Body: Publish one or more service packages with a clear price. Think reels, UGC clips, photo sets — whatever you do best.
forCreators.flow3Body: Once approved, your profile appears in search. Businesses filter by niche, market, and budget to find you.
forCreators.flow4Body: When a business books you, review the brief, accept (and get paid into escrow), then deliver the content.
forCreators.flow5Body: When the business approves your delivery, your payout goes out the same day via Stripe — straight to your bank account.
forCreators.earningsSubtitle: Real creators on Sprace earn based on what they deliver — you keep 85 % of every booking.
forCreators.earningsDisclaimer: Earnings vary based on your audience size, niche, and the brief. Amounts shown are typical ranges observed on the platform.
forCreators.ctaSubtitle: Setting up your profile takes about 10 minutes. It's completely free to join.

forBusinesses.heroSubtitle: Stop sourcing creators in DMs. Sprace gives you a vetted roster of influencers and UGC creators, transparent pricing, and a built-in workflow — from brief to final delivery.
forBusinesses.benefitsSubtitle: Everything you need to run creator campaigns at speed.
forBusinesses.benefit1Body: Every creator is reviewed before going live. Browse active profiles, real portfolios, and verified reviews from other brands.
forBusinesses.benefit2Body: Creators list services with clear prices — no negotiation loops, no hidden fees. What you see is what you pay.
forBusinesses.benefit3Body: Pay upfront into escrow. Funds are only released when your content is delivered and you approve it. Full refund if the booking is cancelled.
forBusinesses.benefit4Body: Send a structured brief with title, description, budget, and deadline. Creators accept and go — most deliveries land within days.
forBusinesses.benefit5Body: Messages, files, revisions, approvals — every booking has its own thread. No more scattered email chains.
forBusinesses.benefit6Body: Request revisions when content doesn't hit the brief. A configurable number of rounds is included in every booking.
forBusinesses.flowSubtitle: From brief to approved content in under a week.
forBusinesses.flow1Body: Sign up, add your company details, and you're ready to browse.
forBusinesses.flow2Body: Filter by specialty, market, audience size, and rate. Save favourites for later.
forBusinesses.flow3Body: Pick a service package, add your brief, set the deadline and budget. The creator sees everything they need to accept.
forBusinesses.flow4Body: When the creator accepts, you pay via Stripe. Funds are held securely until the work is approved.
forBusinesses.flow5Body: The creator delivers through the platform. Request revisions if needed, or approve to release the payment and wrap the booking.

howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: A single platform for creators and businesses — with separate flows designed for each side.
howItWorksPage.creatorsTabSubtitle: List your services. Get booked. Get paid.
howItWorksPage.businessesTabSubtitle: Brief creators. Pay safely. Approve deliveries.
howItWorksPage.creatorStep1Body: Pick the creator role, add your bio, social links, and portfolio pieces. Our team reviews your profile within 48 hours before it goes public.
howItWorksPage.creatorStep2Body: Create clear, priced services — a UGC clip, an Instagram reel, a campaign package. Businesses book directly from these.
howItWorksPage.creatorStep3Body: When a business sends a brief, you review title, description, budget, and deadline. Accept and the business is asked to pay into escrow.
howItWorksPage.creatorStep4Body: Upload files, leave a note, and submit. Request revisions work through the same thread — everything is versioned and auditable.
howItWorksPage.creatorStep5Body: When the business approves, your payout is released via Stripe. You keep 85 % of the booking value.
howItWorksPage.businessStep1Body: Sign up as a business, add your company details, and you're ready to browse creators.
howItWorksPage.businessStep2Body: Filter by specialty, market, audience size, and rate. Save favourites for later or jump straight into a booking.
howItWorksPage.businessStep3Body: Pick a service package, describe what you need, set a deadline, and send. The creator reviews and accepts.
howItWorksPage.businessStep4Body: When the creator accepts, you pay via Stripe. Funds are held securely until you approve the delivery.
howItWorksPage.businessStep5Body: Review the delivery, request revisions if needed, then approve. Payment releases automatically and the booking is closed.
howItWorksPage.safetySubtitle: The platform protects both sides. These features are included on every booking — no add-ons.
howItWorksPage.safety1Body: Funds are held by Stripe until delivery is approved. Creators know they'll be paid; businesses know their money is safe.
howItWorksPage.safety2Body: Every creator is manually reviewed before going live. No spam profiles, no fake portfolios.
howItWorksPage.safety3Body: If something goes wrong, either side can open a dispute. Our team reviews and can issue refunds or release payment.
howItWorksPage.safety4Body: Data stored in the EU. Self-service account deletion and data export. No tracking cookies.
howItWorksPage.ctaSubtitle: Creating an account is free — you only pay when you book (businesses) or when you earn (creators).

pricing.faq1Q: Do I pay anything to sign up?
pricing.faq1A: No. Creating a profile, browsing creators, and exchanging messages is completely free for both creators and businesses.
pricing.faq2Q: When is the platform fee charged?
pricing.faq2A: Only when a booking is accepted by the creator. The business pays the full amount (booking + 15 % fee) into escrow, and funds are released once the delivery is approved.
pricing.faq3A: The current fee is 15 %. If we ever update it, it will only apply to new bookings — existing bookings use the fee agreed at acceptance.
pricing.faq4Q: What happens if a booking is cancelled?
pricing.faq4A: Before delivery, businesses get a full refund — including the platform fee. After delivery, cancellations are handled through our dispute resolution process.
pricing.faq5A: No. There are no subscriptions, listing fees, or success fees beyond the 15 % platform fee. Payment processing is covered by Stripe's standard fees, which we absorb.

about.heroTitle: Building the home of Nordic creator marketing
about.heroSubtitle: Sprace is a marketplace for influencers, UGC creators, and the brands that want to work with them — without the spreadsheet admin, unpaid invoices, or endless DM threads.
about.missionTitle: One place where briefs become paid collaborations
about.missionBody1: Creator marketing has grown up, but the tooling hasn't. Briefs still live in DMs, invoices still get paid late, and disputes still rely on goodwill. We think there is a better way — and it starts by treating creators like the small businesses they are.
about.missionBody2: Sprace combines a discovery marketplace, a booking workflow, escrow payments, and a delivery review loop into a single product. Brands get what they paid for. Creators get paid when they deliver. Nobody has to chase an invoice.
about.stat2Label: Flat platform fee — no hidden costs
about.stat3Label: Average time from brief to first reply
about.valuesSubtitle: A short list of principles we use to decide what to build — and what not to build.
about.value1Body: Every decision starts with the creator. If a feature makes life easier for a brand but harder for a creator, we don't ship it.
about.value2Body: Fees are visible upfront. Payouts are predictable. Disputes follow a documented process. No surprises.
about.value3Body: We prefer one well-designed flow over three flashy features. The product should fade into the background so the work can take center stage.
about.value4Body: We build for the Nordic market first — Swedish orgnummer, SEK payouts, GDPR-aware defaults — and expand from there.
about.storyBody1: Sprace started with a simple observation: the best creators in the Nordics were spending more time managing logistics than creating content. Chasing invoices, re-reading briefs, renegotiating scope.
about.storyBody2: We built the product we wished existed — a marketplace with the structure of a real B2B tool, but the warmth of a creative community. Upfront payments. Clear scope. Built-in delivery review. GDPR-compliant by construction.
about.storyBody3: We're based in Stockholm and we're building Sprace in public. If you have feedback — or you just want to say hello — we'd love to hear from you.
about.ctaSubtitle: Whether you create content or buy it, Sprace is a better way to work.

legal.privacyIntroBody: Sprace AB ("Sprace", "we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and share your personal data when you use our platform. Sprace operates as an influencer and UGC marketplace connecting creators with businesses.
legal.dataCollectionBody: We collect data you provide directly: your name, email address, profile information (biography, social media links, portfolio), company information, communication through our messaging system, payment details (processed by Stripe), and uploaded media files. We also collect usage data such as login activity, feature usage patterns, and technical information like your browser type and IP address.
legal.dataUsageBody: Your data is used to provide and improve our services: matching creators with businesses, processing payments, facilitating communication, sending service-related notifications, and ensuring platform security. We may also use anonymized, aggregated data for analytics and product improvement.
legal.dataSharingBody: We share your data only with: Stripe (payment processing), Supabase (infrastructure and data storage, with servers in the EU), email service providers for transactional notifications, and other users as necessary for the marketplace to function (e.g., your public profile is visible to businesses). We never sell your personal data to third parties.
legal.dataStorageBody: Your data is stored on servers within the European Union via our infrastructure provider Supabase. We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, row-level security policies, and regular security reviews. Payment data is handled entirely by Stripe and never stored on our servers.
legal.userRightsBody: As a data subject under GDPR, you have the right to: access your personal data, rectify inaccurate data, request erasure of your data (right to be forgotten), export your data in a portable format, restrict or object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time. You can exercise most of these rights directly in your account settings. To delete your account, go to Settings → Data & Privacy → Delete Account. To export your data, use the data export feature in the same section.
legal.cookiesBody: Sprace uses only essential cookies required for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics cookies. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are necessary for the platform to function.
legal.contactBody: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your data rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@sprace.com or write to: Sprace AB, Stockholm, Sweden.
legal.termsIntroBody: Welcome to Sprace. By creating an account or using our platform, you agree to these Terms of Service. Sprace is a marketplace that connects influencers and UGC creators ("Creators") with businesses ("Businesses") for content creation and marketing collaborations.
legal.accountsBody: You must be at least 18 years old to use Sprace. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You may register as a Creator or a Business — each role has different features and responsibilities. You must provide accurate information during registration and keep your profile up to date.
legal.platformUsageBody: You agree to use Sprace in accordance with applicable laws and these terms. Prohibited activities include: impersonating others, posting fraudulent or misleading content, harassing other users, attempting to circumvent platform fees by arranging payments outside the platform, and any activity that could harm the platform or its users.
legal.paymentsBody: All payments are processed through Stripe. A platform fee (currently 15%) is charged on each completed booking. Businesses pay the full amount at booking acceptance, which is held in escrow until the booking is completed. Creators receive their payout (minus the platform fee) when the business approves the delivery. Refund policies are outlined in our dispute resolution process.
legal.intellectualPropertyBody: Creators retain ownership of their original content. By delivering content through a booking, the Creator grants the Business a license to use the content as specified in the booking brief. Sprace does not claim ownership of any user-generated content. The Sprace brand, logo, and platform design are the intellectual property of Sprace AB.
legal.disputeResolutionBody: If a dispute arises between a Creator and a Business, either party may open a dispute through the platform. Sprace will review the dispute and may: issue a full refund to the Business, release the payment to the Creator, arrange a partial resolution, or dismiss the dispute. Sprace's decision is final in the context of platform transactions. This does not affect your legal rights.
legal.limitationOfLiabilityBody: Sprace acts as a marketplace and facilitator. We are not a party to the agreements between Creators and Businesses. We do not guarantee the quality of services or content. Our liability is limited to the platform fees collected. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the platform.
legal.terminationBody: You may delete your account at any time through Settings → Data & Privacy → Delete Account. Sprace may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. Upon termination, your data will be deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy, subject to legal retention requirements.
legal.changesToTermsBody: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notification. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
legal.contactBody: For questions about these terms, contact us at legal@sprace.com or write to: Sprace AB, Stockholm, Sweden.
